messages.subject_clean: Query regarding latest idea discussion for GSOC '13
messages.body_plain:
hello everyone,

I am Pulkit Mehrotra. I am a 4th year  student at IIT Kharagpur doing my Masters in Financial Engineering. I have started working  on R last year during my summer Internship and was amazed by the scope and ease of functionality of the language for financial computation. I have done few projects in finance and am interested in learning and contributing  to R.

I am looking forward to applying to GSOC this year . Is there any place where the ideas regarding the current GSOC are being discussed or list which the current aspirants can go though before applying for a new idea. I didn't find any page on rwiki.scieviews.org <http://rwiki.scieviews.org> where such ideas are being discussed. Is this the main place where the idea discussion shall take place ?

Thank you for your time and consideration.
Hoping for R being accepted this GSOC :)

best regards,
Pulkit Mehrotra
